role: Routine, session-note and body-weight scalar records
known_patches: Account 1/2 synthetic personas; original privilege flags retained
Real optional name/bool/date/routine filters; original guards and scopes retained
limitations: All 199 source tools remain; only nine listed write tools are certified.
workoutsession_update checks ownership of supplied routine_id rather than target session; weightentry_delete has an OR branch allowing any existing account. These are retained source ACL gaps.

WorkoutSession.routine_id/day_id relation is not jointly validated; updates to id-typed FK fields are ignored by original runtime. Pass routine_id for the original update guard and use scalar fields only.
workoutlog_create actually upserts WorkoutSession, not WorkoutLog; exercise_delete inserts DeletionLog without deleting Exercise. Neither effect is certified here.
Routine structure/stats/nutritional-values tools fetch scalar rows and do not implement full calculations. Media/file tools are metadata-only; no binary transfer claim.
Owner/public visibility differs across source reads; full routine search/public-template semantics and descendant ACL isolation are not certified.

Original runtime auto-generates the same WeightEntry.uuid for repeated inserts lacking a name/id input. A second distinct-date weightentry_create can hit a UUID uniqueness conflict; this is reproduced in unsupported_interface_probes.json.
